source_visual_limits: Finite camera views at 0.5 seconds; playback at five times is checked separately by the native reader.
Lit screenshots are qualitative. Exact PNG bytes, native decoded pixels, UVs, material factors and color-space formula have separate independent readbacks.
The oblique tray view partly occludes its floor; the underside does not expose the pocket interior.
The generated repaired middle panel intentionally overlaps its right sibling because the same authored parameter controls placement and mapping.
The RGB panel source was decoded and validated, but its duplicate-revision reference name resolves to an uncaptured case; RGB grids are directly visible in the assembly/generated captures.
No Unreal import, live-engine physics or universal feature acceptance is inferred.
agent_visual_limits: A single still at 0.5 seconds cannot independently prove the motion trajectory; the separate native browser JSON records five sampled poses.
Lit screenshot colors are not quantitative proof of sRGB decoding, exact linear multiplication, alpha bytes, sampler constants, or UV binary values.
Front and oblique views do not expose every side, underside, hidden triangle, or every possible camera angle.
Exactly 14 Agent captures were inspected here; the 21 source captures are assigned to the parent reviewer. Only 35 captures exist in this destination run.

The dedicated source rgb-panel capture is absent because the revision alias resolves to filter-0. Do not claim a nonexistent standalone RGB capture. RGB patterns are directly visible in the inspected assembly and generated Agent captures.
Seven of the nine Agent GLB artifacts have captured views. Existing native report results cover all nine; this direct image review covers only the seven represented in the capture inventory.
This finite Three.js/Chromium visual inspection does not establish Unreal import, live contact physics, general scene coverage, or full project completion.
destination.destination_scope: Pinned Khronos and real native-image Three.js/Chromium source-derived UV/pixel/material/pose readback, with finite captured views. No claim of Unreal import or live contact physics.
destination.color_precision_boundary: Independent binary64 source formula checks and actual Float32 GPU probes are separate; midpoint GPU probes do not claim the 1e-12 CPU tolerance.

global_limits: This is a finite review of the exact 35 PNG files in six inherited browser artifact directories. It excludes workspace/source PNG fixtures and is separate from the 35 C080 texture destination captures.
All 35 files were directly viewed in this run, including any that may coincidentally share a historical PNG hash. Exact prior attribution count is zero.

Three legacy visual-browser captures have no embedded screenshot hash in their browser report. Their names match the report, and this inventory computes and binds their actual file hashes; it does not invent a prior capture-hash attestation.
Several native/surface side cameras align multiple objects along the sightline. Occluded members, rear caps and hidden facets cannot be independently assessed in those images.

The ordinary/generated composition stills can retain the same fitted projection at different times; they do not alone demonstrate world displacement. Numeric browser pose checks and independent delivered-byte checks are separate evidence.
Whole-recording camera fits make P04/P11 and some generated members small. Their screenshots show finite silhouettes and sampled changes, with limited fine-detail assessment.
Lit colors and displayed material labels are qualitative. They do not quantitatively prove color transfer, roughness, metallicity, source identity, winding, topology or exact binary streams.
Still captures show only their recorded times and camera views. They do not establish continuous-time accuracy, every supported program, all possible views, or arbitrary renderer compatibility.
The viewers play recorded GLB transforms. The images do not establish Blender/Unreal import, live impulses or contact physics, a measured authoring benefit, or full-product completion.
Existing held gates, original failed fixtures, external pending attestations, other interpreter roles and the broader GOAL remain governed by their separately identified evidence.
